patterns.note: The site uses a full-bleed hero video with overlaid text, followed by a flexible grid layout for product displays that sometimes breaks into full-width lifestyle imagery.

A highly distinctive, large serif font is used for the main brand title and section headings, creating an elegant and established feel, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
An earthy and muted color palette dominates, featuring warm terracotta browns, deep olive greens, and creamy off-whites, evoking a natural and sophisticated aesthetic.
The hero section features a video background with a pronounced parallax effect, where both the video and the large overlaid brand title move at different speeds as the user scrolls down the page.
Product showcase sections frequently intersperse individual product shots with large, immersive lifestyle photography, blurring the lines between product display and brand storytelling.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero video plays on loop, with a strong parallax effect applied to both the video background and the overlaid brand title, creating depth as the user scrolls, likely leveraging locomotive-scroll.
Sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, often accompanied by a background color change, indicating scroll-triggered animation.

A persistent top navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining brand presence and access to key actions, while a promotional banner above it dynamically changes content on scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body text) with generous letter spacing, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for most elements, with subtle rounding for input fields and some product images.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy overall, especially in the hero and between major sections, with a balanced density within product grids and a generous, multi-column footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a grand, elegant serif typeface for branding and headings, combined with a rich, earthy color palette and subtle parallax motion, creates a luxurious and artisanal feel that elevates it beyond typical e-commerce sites. The integration of lifestyle imagery directly into product grids is also notable.
